ambient_chatter.text: the fens have rained on me for three days straight and i have decided it is a personal attack on me specifically
{town} bridge still owes me an apology. it has not said sorry once. i am keeping a list
lag again?? the sacred chicken has never lagged once in its whole life. be like the chicken :)
anyone else hear crows over {village} last night or was that just me being haunted by the pigeon guild
walked into {village} soaked and the innkeeper gave me a goose-shaped towel. i am keeping it. i have never felt so loved

ambient_brag.text: {troop_count} men at {fief} and every single one has been told about the pigeon. we are unstoppable. also soggy
i have {gold} in the coin pouch, mostly from people paying me to stop singing at them. the sacred chicken is proud
{fief} is ours. the walls are damp, the moat is loud and {troop_count} spears point at the sky out of respect
counted {gold} this morning. the ledger says i am rich. the ledger is also wet, so i am choosing to believe it
{troop_count} soldiers, one horn, zero plan, and somehow we are winning. ser, the weather is doing this for me

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat my {troop_count} lads and i am choosing to blame the fog. the fog has been notified :)
well fought, {player}. you marched my {troop_count} into the mud. i blame the fog, you blame your boots, we both win
ha! you won this round, {player}. the pigeon is still on my side though, and so is the rain. see you in the next muddy field
{player}, that flank was sneaky and the storm noticed. i'll be back with {troop_count} more and a worse attitude
lost to {player} at the fens with {troop_count} lads in tow. the flood took my boots and my dignity, not my horn

beat_player.text: {player} lost {troop_count} men to my horn and a sky that hates everyone equally. the sky is so pleased right now
told you the weather was on my side, {player}. {gold} richer and still soaked. the gold is mine, the mud is yours
{player}! magnificent defeat, truly. the pigeon has been informed and it is extremely smug about it
good scrap, {player}. i took {troop_count} of your lot and {gold} worth of loot, so we are square and i am starving
{player} got beaten by a horn and a goose-shaped towel. {troop_count} prisoners, {gold} gold, and a tragic amount of mud

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} ran from me. ran! the ducks saw it, the fens saw it, and i will never forgive the ducks or the fens
running already, {player}? i was going to be merciful. the rain is sad about this and so am i, a little
{player} took one look at my horn and bolted. wise. the horn is not even loaded. it is decorative now
scurried off like a wet rat, {player}. i will find you by the squeak of those boots
{player} saw the pigeon and ran. honest reaction. the pigeon is unarmed but it has a reputation

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won so many fights in a row the fens are asking questions. i am asking questions too. i want my dignity back
winning all the time, {player}? i have a horn and a wet grudge and both are ready for you
{player} is on a streak and honestly good for them. the rain is jealous. i am not jealous. i am a little jealous
{player}, the whole server is whispering about your streak. i am proud of you. i will ruin it eventually, that is love
{player} thinks they are unbeatable. the sky has opinions and the sky is on my side. see you at the next ford

peace_made.text: peace with {faction}? i am suspicious. they signed with a feather pen that was dripping. my {my_faction} lads cried a little
{my_faction} and {faction} made peace. i have lost my favourite excuse to shout and i am very bored about it now
the treaty with {faction} is signed, so no horn blasts for a week. i am bored already and it has been ten minutes
{faction} and {my_faction} shook hands. i saw it from my tent. it was thunderous. literally, the sky applauded

war_declared.text: {enemy_faction} has declared war on {my_faction}. horns out, bridges worried, pigeons on duty. my favourite kind of Tuesday
war with {enemy_faction}! finally something to do. my lads have been polishing spears for three days and the spears are wet
{my_faction} is at war with {enemy_faction} and i am the only one who packed a raincoat. be ready, ser
{enemy_faction} wants a fight with {my_faction}. wonderful. i will bring the sacred chicken. the chicken is furious

encounter_greeting.text: {player}! it is {persona} of {my_faction}, and you have been on my list since the fens. drop your banner and face the horn
ho there, {player}. {persona} here, soaked and very dramatic. my {my_faction} lads are watching, so please be dignified
{player}, my favourite wet friend! {persona} of {my_faction} salutes you. the pigeon has been briefed and approves of you
{player}, we have met before and i still have feelings about it. {persona} of {my_faction} says stand aside or be drenched
ser {player}, {persona} of {my_faction} at your service. mind the puddles, they are mostly my fault

whisper_taunt.text: {player}, i saw you walk past {rival} like they were not ruining every village. the horn remembers. so do i
still thinking about the fens, {player}. {rival} ran faster than you did and i respect that. you did not. ha
{rival} owes me three villages and an apology, {player}. you can carry the message. bring a towel
hey {player}. tell {rival} the bridge is still mine. the bridge agrees, the horn agrees, the weather agrees
{player}, your banner looks like a wet sock. {rival} should be ashamed to stand next to you :)
